title: 2026 purchased heat and steam CHP QA controls

sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors: methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Purchased heat and steam factors were held constant from the 2025 release in the 2026 publication.
The factors are aligned with AR5 global-warming-potential values.
The factors represent average emissions from heat and steam supplied by UK CHPQA scheme operators.
The underlying heat and steam factor can vary by year as the CHP fuel mix changes.
The methodology normally updates the factor annually when source data change.
No statistics are available for calculating a UK national average heat and steam factor from non-CHP operations.
facts.expected_handling: Do not invent non-CHP national factor.

facts.source_fact: Combined heat and power simultaneously produces both heat and electricity.
Emissions from CHP therefore require an allocation convention between heat and electricity outputs.
Possible allocation conventions range from assigning emissions wholly to one product to intermediate proportions.
facts.expected_handling: Do not assume a single universal allocation without method.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 methodology retains a documented CHP allocation method rather than treating purchased heat as direct on-site combustion.
